scope: The demo path, part three: image dependencies against what the node imports
finding: the Dockerfile installed python3-pip, libgl1, libgomp1 and ros-humble-rviz2 on top of ros:humble-ros-base-jammy, and relied on the base image for geometry_msgs and tf2_ros. The node imports both, and this pass added the tf2_ros import for the fixed frame, so the dependency is now declared explicitly rather than inherited: ros-humble-tf2-ros.
second_finding: the build smoke-check verified the native extension but not the ROS-side imports, so a missing ROS dependency would have surfaced at demonstration time rather than build time. The build now also imports tunnel_guard.ros_node, which fails the image build if any import is unavailable.
why_it_matters: a container that builds but whose node cannot import is indistinguishable from a working one until someone plays a bag in front of the judges
verification_status: static change to the Dockerfile; not built here (no daemon on the development machine)
